svg.aria-label: A den on a diorama base: the anatomy of den. Inside a caged den, three wild robot animals (a wolf, a fox, and a raccoon at a crate) are the coding agents in the VM. Outside, a robot T-Rex runs the den from a console with its tiny arms; one cable runs from the console through a sealed gland into the den. A gold key cartridge is fed through a hatch, the only way keys go in, a beacon on the corner post keeps the den alive, and there is no door.
